summary.one_liner: A prototype autonomous HR assistant that answers employee and timekeeping-policy questions using a LangChain agent with ChatGPT, Pinecone, and a Streamlit front end.
summary.what_it_does: The agent chooses among three tools to answer HR queries: a timekeeping policy document embedded with OpenAI's text-embedding-ada-002 and stored in a Pinecone index, a dummy employee CSV loaded as a pandas DataFrame and queried through LangChain's PythonAstREPLTool, and LangChain's LLMMathChain calculator. The LLM is ChatGPT or gpt-3.5-turbo, and the chat UI uses Streamlit with the streamlit_chat component. A notebook is provided to create the Pinecone embeddings. The README also describes an Azure variant (hr_agent_backend_azure.py) and an Azure Data Lake, Data Factory, and SAP HCM data pipeline as the intended enterprise context. A 2026 note says a modernized v2/ version uses OpenAI's Responses API with no LangChain or Pinecone, and gpt-5.2 reasoning summaries; the original 2023 code is kept for reference.
use_cases: Answering employee questions about timekeeping policies
Looking up dummy employee records such as supervisor and leave balances
Prototyping an internal HR chatbot with LangChain agents
Learning how to combine vector search with a pandas data tool in an agent
Demonstrating a Streamlit chat front end for an LLM agent
how_to_run: Clone the repository to a local directory.
Add your own API keys in hr_agent_backend_local.py (or hr_agent_backend_azure.py for the Azure version, uncommenting it in frontend.py).
Create a Pinecone account and run the notebook store_embeddings_in_pinecone.ipynb with your Pinecone and OpenAI keys to store embeddings.
notable: Agent picks between a vector-searched policy document, a pandas-based employee data tool, and a calculator
Employee data is queried by letting the LLM run Python via LangChain's PythonAstREPLTool
Includes both an OpenAI-direct backend and an Azure OpenAI backend variant
A 2026 v2/ folder rewrites it with OpenAI's Responses API, dropping LangChain and Pinecone
caveats: Described as a prototype; the sample policy document and employee CSV are generated or dummy data
Requires API keys for OpenAI and Pinecone (free tier available) and a Python 3.10 environment
The original 2023 implementation is kept as reference; the modernized version is in v2/
